summary: Configured and verified the HA Prometheus/Thanos metrics service with authenticated HTTPS MinIO storage and reboot-persistent security controls.
actions_performed: Prometheus replicas on node1/node2 scrape all four node exporters with unique replica labels.
Thanos sidecars, query, store gateway, and compactor are enabled and active.
node3 query deduplicates replicas and returns four current host series; object storage contains verified historical blocks.
MinIO serves the thanos-metrics bucket over HTTPS on node4 with root-only credentials and data under /srv/thanos-objectstore.
Created root-only /root/thanos-objectstore.env on node3 with endpoint, credentials, and CA path.
Enabled UFW firewall rules and persistent systemd services on all nodes.
